tournament_name: Colorado Annual Women's Weekend: Flee the Nest
details:
**CAWW Flies Again!  The Colorado Annual Women's Weekend (CAWW) is an event dedicated to women’s pinball in Colorado! This event features four IFPA-sanctioned tournaments across three days at Lyons Classic Pinball (LCP) in Lyons, CO.

With 90+ machines and the state’s best collection of classic titles, we’re excited to share a one-of-a-kind experience with both locals and out of state visitors.

Join us for a weekend of competition, laughs, and impeccable fall weather in colorful Colorado.**


**Flee The Nest Strikes Tournament**

Sunday, October 4: 1pm

3 strike knockout.  Players will play in three or four player groups.  Strikes will be given depending on where the player finishes in their match.  In a four player group, 3rd and 4th will receive one strike each.  In a 3 player group, 2nd and 3rd will receive one strike each.  When a player receives their 3rd strike in the tournament, they are eliminated.  Rounds continue until one player remains.  

Top 8 receive payouts!

Tiebreakers/Payouts: Ties will only be broken for the top 8 competitors for position and payouts. Ties will be broken for 1st-4th, but not 5th-8th. The tie will be a full game on a game that is chosen randomly
